purpose: Public planning guides for international education research, applications, funding, immigration preparation, accommodation, and student safety.

statusDefinitions.planned: Registered for future creation. The PDF may not exist and must not be published as a download.
statusDefinitions.draft: The PDF exists but is awaiting content review, verification, or quality assurance.
statusDefinitions.published: The PDF exists, has passed quality assurance, and is approved for public access.
statusDefinitions.outdated: The resource may contain superseded information and must not be promoted as current guidance.
statusDefinitions.archived: The resource is retained for historical or internal reference and is not available as a current public download.

contentStandards: Explain the intended audience and purpose of each guide.
Distinguish general planning advice from official requirements.
Verify immigration, employment, insurance, and entry rules using current official sources.
Explain relevant admission, documentation, funding, and accommodation procedures.
Include official source links and verification dates for time-sensitive information.
Do not invent fees, deadlines, eligibility rules, or visa requirements.
Do not promise admission, scholarships, visa approval, employment, or immigration outcomes.
Clearly label illustrative costs and identify the currency, location, and applicable period.
Explain when readers should consult an official authority or qualified professional.
publishingChecklist: Review content for accuracy, completeness, and relevance.
Confirm the destination country and applicable intake where relevant.
Verify current official government and institutional requirements.
Include working official source links and verification dates where required.
Review document readability, print layout, metadata, and accessibility.
Check hyperlinks, tables, page numbers, and document titles.
Remove personal identity, financial, immigration, and application records.
Confirm the PDF exists in the intended deployment directory.
Confirm the manifest status and website download listing are synchronized.
